session-authority.ai_execution_context: server session plus Membership plus Binding plus capability identity
session-authority.client_authority_boundary: client-supplied tenant, Binding and body authority are never authorization facts
session-authority.session_envelope_boundary: v5 supersedes the v4 ban: routeGrants stays inside the session envelope as a route-list drift detector, not an authorization projection. It is server-generated, never client-submitted, and the client cross-checks it against independently derived expectations so route-list divergence fails the session closed. This required field requires a version bump to media_web_business_pages_v3 and B re-freezes the interface identity at v3.
session-authority.route_authorization_axes: role selects shell; workspaceMode/bodyAuthority select content authority; session routeGrants plus MediaStudioRoutePolicy select visible UI, while backend authorization on every read and action remains final.
session-authority.illegal_route_semantics: navigation may collapse a legal session in the wrong shell to that shell's default route; data and action calls must refuse cross-tenant, cross-owner, missing-grant, or organization-capability requests with 403 or an equivalent no-permission state.
session-authority.route_list_authority: the route list is delegated to mediaStudioRoutePolicy.ts. The remaining hand-maintained duplicates are debt to be collapsed into one generated source.
session-authority.ordinary_ia_entrypoint: MediaStudioApp is the current mounted entry; MediaApp is legacy until an entrypoint census proves otherwise. Do not delete the legacy IA before route ownership and deep-link behavior are recorded.

entry-state.entry_state_authority: the shipped entry-state API carries login entry status only: mode, matched/none/expired/mismatched, masked entry, and fallback. It is a pre-login probe and must never carry role, body authority, route grants, or action grants.
entry-state.entry_state_contract: login entry status and workspace route authorization are two separately versioned contracts and must not share one endpoint or one name. Both are published in OpenAPI and client types; entry-state OpenAPI publication remains a B/T1 delivery item.

writer-authority.personal_body_authority: personal_web/internal; Web is the only editor authority
writer-authority.organization_body_authority: organization_lark/lark; Feishu Docx is the only editor authority
writer-authority.writer_routing: phase 1 I9 first closes every legacy AI document entry and API; phase 2 then atomically replaces that fail-closed state with the one WriterRouter
writer-authority.capability_side_effects: server registry declares read sets and document side effects; read-only capabilities write nothing
writer-authority.cutover_policy: no long-lived dual authority, dual writers, legacy writer path, implicit fallback or global Feishu credential fallback; authority-preserving allowlists, release gates, kill switches and external-write stops are allowed
writer-authority.cross_stage_gates: stage1 C1 unlocks shared/personal work, C3 unlocks organization work and the exclusive WriterRouter, DC2 gates the unique phase2 candidate

artifact-closure.artifact_closure: write, artifact registration and required readback must all succeed before publish success
artifact-closure.tenant_data_scope: all context sources, including 01 recent activity, use the same tenant boundary

delivery-boundary.font_delivery: self-host DM Sans as full WOFF2; serve Noto Sans SC through unicode-range slices or a curated common-glyph subset; preload only Latin subset and keep a local fallback chain
delivery-boundary.font_weight_policy: load every used weight including 600; remove 800/850 visual dependence, map Chinese headings to available weights, set Chinese or mixed headings letter-spacing to 0 and reserve negative tracking for pure Latin/numeric display
delivery-boundary.stage3_exclusions: full role matrix, approval, seats, procurement, invoices, migration, complex deletion and business analytics

surface.inputs: S1 到 S5 和 T1 的已接受输出
surface.processing: 核对上下文、资料、写入、成果、回读、能力目录和 OpenAPI 的唯一组合同
surface.task: 汇合共享合同和实现；不组装最终候选。
surface.output: 共享路由不可变子候选
surface.tests: 合同生成、能力矩阵、错容器、失败状态、跨租户和禁止旧 Writer 检查
surface.acceptance: 所有文档能力只有一个路由入口
surface.definition_of_done: 接受后可独立支持已解锁的个人或组织支线

S1.inputs: B 合同、服务端会话、成员关系、Binding 和能力编号
S1.processing: 生成可信的租户、工作区、正文权威、成员角色、Binding 和能力组合结果；为入口状态投影提供服务端事实
S1.tests: 字段来源、缺失、撤销、伪造和组织 A/B 负例
S1.acceptance: 上下文全部由服务端事实生成

S2.inputs: S1 执行上下文、租户资料和资料所有者登记
S2.processing: 按个人或组织工作区选择可用资料，关闭近期活动全表读取等跨租户断点
S2.tests: 个人/组织正例、资料所有者、跨租户、缺失和重复资料负例
S2.acceptance: 01_ 近期活动与其他资料使用同等租户边界

S3.inputs: F2 接受的阶段边界、S1 执行上下文、B 正文权威合同和第一阶段 I9 失败关闭回执
S3.processing: 从第一阶段统一能力不可用状态原子切换到唯一服务端路由；个人文档写入内部 Web 成果，组织文档写入活跃 Binding 的飞书 Docx
S3.tests: 能力矩阵、关闭态接管、正反路由、第一阶段 I7 零人工智能写入、只读能力零副作用和缺失 Binding 负例
S3.acceptance: 不允许第一阶段或能力实现绕过统一路由自选文档容器

S4.inputs: S3 写入结果、文档成果模型、修订和飞书镜像合同
S4.processing: 用幂等收据登记容器、正文权威、远端绑定、修订或回读版本，部分成功进入待处置
S4.tests: 写入失败、登记失败、回读失败、重放、并发和版本冲突测试
S4.acceptance: 任一必要步骤失败都不得返回发布成功

S5.inputs: 现有能力注册表、S1 执行上下文和 S3 写入合同
S5.processing: 为每个能力声明可读资料、是否产生文档、允许容器和必需回读，由服务端强制
S5.tests: 公开/运维/维护能力、只读咨询、写文档、未登记和越权负例
S5.acceptance: 只读能力不产生文档或远端副作用

T1.inputs: B 冻结合同和 K 第 5 版决定
T1.processing: 维护请求合同、上下文类型、入口状态接口、错误码、审计、C/B 正负例、真实会话矩阵和同收据端到端合同
T1.tests: 合同漂移、会话信封加字段、入口状态越权、前端夹带权威字段、跨租户、错容器、写入回读失败和字体弱网回退红灯
T1.acceptance: 每个稳定失败类都有红绿门禁
